findings.title: Pinned Vivi voice settings remain mutable
findings.why_it_matters: The requested Vivi preset is a fixed task contract, but the config API accepts any valid speaker, pitch, rate, volume, and instruction. A saved config can therefore produce a task with a different voice or reading behavior while still being labeled as the pinned Doubao Vivi option; the UI exposes those changes directly.
findings.suggested_fix: Assuming 'pinned' means the specified values must be immutable, make validate_tts require equality with DEFAULT_TTS for every field and show those values as read-only in the UI. Keep the optional tts field itself so older local-TTS configs remain valid.
evidence: device/lira/dictation_cloud_tts.py:17:     if type(value['speaker']) is not str or not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}',value['speaker']):raise ValueError('tts: 音色编号无效')
device/lira/dictation_cloud_tts.py:18-21: pitch, speech_rate, loudness_rate, and instruction are validated by ranges/length rather than against DEFAULT_TTS.
device/lira/ui/static/dictation.js:14: The config POST serializes editable tts-speaker, tts-pitch, tts-rate, tts-volume, and tts-instruction fields.

testing_gaps: No focused compatibility test sends an older v2 task without manual_navigation to the updated TV and verifies it retains the original confirm/left/right behavior.
No focused transport test verifies that a manual_navigation task is rejected before asset upload when the TV lacks dictation_manual_navigation_v1.
